finding.message: The isolated worktree had no Ajv installation, so the required tests did not reach discovery. The host can supply the parent repository's already-installed dependencies without changing source or installing packages.

requiredCorrections: Bind the host's existing node_modules directory into the isolated worktree as runtime supply.
Rerun the exact focused behavioral tests; repair only allowlisted files if a test exposes a candidate defect.
Return pass only when both syntax checks and the focused test suite complete successfully.
